readme.text:
Generative UI for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
Interactive, rich components rendered inline alongside the model's textual responses.

[](./CHANGELOG.md) [](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-genui) [](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-genui) [](LICENSE) [](https://www.typescriptlang.org/) [](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

English · 简体中文

🌐 Live Product Site · 🎬 Real Demo · 🚀 Quick Start · 🧩 Feature Matrix · 📖 Component Syntax (SKILL.md)

--- `dsh-genui` turns DeepSeek Harness (DSH) assistant replies into **safe, fully interactive UI surfaces**. Ask “How are this month’s orders doing?”, and instead of plain text or raw code blocks, the response streams out an **interactive sortable data table**, **audio/video players**, **draggable function plots**, **self-grading quizzes**, or a **persistent workspace dock** — all embedded seamlessly within the conversation.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **This repository is a fork** of `@changfenhuang/dsh-genui` 0.14.0 (package name kept for drop-in compatibility), versioned `0.14.0-fork.3`. Delta over upstream: the diagram engine is **pele** instead of mermaid (1.02 MB, −70% asset weight, live CSS-variable theming, `mindmap`/`timeline` whitelisted), plus capability additions — `chart` `kind:"area"`, native `date` / `datetime-local` / `time` / `number` inputs with `min`/`max`/`step`, automatic table pagination (`pageSize`, row cap raised to 200), and upstream's **Computed fields** (input-driven local recalculation, ported from the 0.15.0 fix line). See [FORK.md](./FORK.md) and the CHANGELOG for the full record. **This fork is not published to npm** — the Quick Start below separates the upstream npm install from building this fork from source.

> [!NOTE]
> **Real Interface Captures:** All recordings and screenshots below are captured directly from real DSH interface rendering — no conceptual mockups or faked pre-renders. Demo media is inherited from the upstream repository: this fork carries the entire component surface shown here, with only the diagram engine swapped (pele instead of mermaid).

Ensure your environment meets the following requirements:
- **DSH Version**: `^0.2.0-rc.1 || ^0.2.1-rc.1` (verified against `dsh-v0.2.0-rc.1` and `dsh-v0.2.1-rc.2`)
- **pnpm on PATH**: The `dsh plugin` CLI requires pnpm. If missing: run `corepack enable` or `npm i -g pnpm`, then **open a new terminal** and confirm `pnpm -v` prints a version number.

Pick one path depending on what you want:

**Option A — Upstream package from npm** (the stable marketplace version, *without* this fork's deltas — pele engine, `area` charts, table pagination, Computed fields, etc.):

1. Restart the DSH web service and **hard refresh** your browser (`Cmd + Shift + R` or `Ctrl + F5`).
2. In a **new conversation session**, send:
   ```text
   Use dsh-ui to draw a stats dashboard with a sortable service table.
   ```
3. **Expected result**: The reply renders an in-place interactive dashboard rather than a plain code block.
4. **Console activation check**: Open your browser Developer Tools Console and look for `[genui] client active; fence-channel=dom`.

---

> [!WARNING]
> ### ⚠️ Installation Pitfalls to Avoid
> 
> 1. **Watch the Package Scope (Crucial)**:
>    The package must be **`@changfenhuang/dsh-genui`**. npm hosts an unrelated, unscoped package named `dsh-genui` (a Vue/OpenTiny implementation by another maintainer); installing it will fail due to incompatible host peer dependencies.
> 2. **Do Not Use `link:` on a Directory That Has Not Been Built**:
>    `link:` alone does not bundle or resolve peer assets (diagram engine, three.js, React). Run `pnpm install` plus the build gate first so `lib/` exists, then `link:` works — that is exactly Option B above. Use npm (Option A) for the standard marketplace install.
> 3. **Migrating from Legacy `@omdsh-dev`**:
>    If you installed from GitHub or the old org name before v0.9.2, clean up the stale key:
>    ```sh
>    dsh plugin --profile web remove @omdsh-dev/dsh-genui
>    dsh plugin --profile web add @changfenhuang/dsh-genui
>    ```

Every component and behavior is guarded by the strict `dsh-ui` specification. See [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md) for full JSON schema details.

```
dsh-genui Capabilities
├── 🌊 1. Streaming & Realtime Mounting
├── 🎨 2. 30+ Component Ecosystem
├── ⚡ 3. Local-First Responsiveness

- **Answer-as-UI**: Components stream into the conversation as tokens arrive, mounting incrementally without waiting for the full reply to finish.
- **Graceful Fallback**: If the plugin is absent or disabled, fences degrade cleanly to standard Markdown code blocks without breaking the chat history.

- **Zero-Latency Interactions**: State transitions that the frontend can handle alone (sorting, filtering, accordion toggling, slider redraws, tab switches) execute **entirely client-side** without round-trips to the model.
- **Quizzes & Submission (`quiz` / `submit`)**:
  - Single quizzes evaluate instantly with explanations and retry options;
  - Multi-question assessments support batch grading and progress tracking with the `groups` schema.
- **Durable Persistence**: User inputs, form fields, and quiz states persist across page reloads via session fingerprints (LRU cache of 200 blocks).

- **Closed-Loop Interactions**: Interactive elements equipped with an `action` payload package user events back to the model to trigger follow-up reasoning.
- **Honest UI Guarantee**: Buttons without an `action` render disabled to eliminate "dead clicks"; active buttons show immediate visual feedback upon trigger.
- **Debounced Delivery**: Discrete taps send immediately; continuous slider drags apply trailing-edge debounce to prevent message flooding.

- **Session Dock Panel**: Open a persistent dock above the composer via `/panel` or `panel: true`; resize by dragging its border; append tabs incrementally with `append: true`.
- **Template Center & Badges**:
  - **Templates**: Browse 11 pre-built scenario templates directly from the dock to kickstart prompts;
  - **Achievements**: Unlock 12 built-in local exploration badges as you interact with various components.

- **Security by Design**: Strictly whitelisted JSON components; zero script injection or `eval`; **strict prohibition of passwords or secret collection**.
- **Same-Turn Fence Steering**: If a generated fence fails validation, diagnostic errors are fed back to the model within the **same turn** so it can self-correct (can be disabled via `fenceFeedback: false`).
- **Resilient Fallbacks**: Malformed nodes are safely discarded while siblings render normally (single node errors never crash the fence); Mermaid syntax glitches are automatically repaired.

Completed GenUI blocks can be exported on demand:
- **Standalone `.html`**: Inlines the lightweight renderer, CSS styles, KaTeX fonts, and required chart engines so the interactive UI can be viewed and tested offline in any browser.
- **`.genui.json`**: Retains the normalized specification and durable interaction states for storage and portability.

Q: Why are dsh-ui fences still showing up as raw code blocks?

1. Open your browser Developer Tools (F12) and inspect the Console.
2. Search for the log `[genui] client active; fence-channel=dom`:
   - **If missing**: The client bundle was not activated by the host. Verify that `dsh plugin list` shows the plugin as active, restart DSH web, and hard refresh your browser;
   - **If present**: Check whether the code block language identifier is strictly `dsh-ui` and that its body contains valid JSON.
</details>

Q: Error: "pnpm not found on PATH"? DSH plugin management calls `pnpm` under the hood. Run `corepack enable` or `npm i -g pnpm`, then **open a new terminal window** before running `dsh plugin add`.
Q: npm install returns 404?

The package is public and requires no login. Verify the package name via `npm view @changfenhuang/dsh-genui version`. If a version was published very recently, allow a few moments for registry mirrors to synchronize.
Q: 3D scene, Mermaid, or ECharts does not render?

Heavier engines are lazy-loaded through plugin-provided static routes upon their first appearance. Hard refresh your browser (`Cmd + Shift + R`). If the issue persists, reinstall the package:
```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @changfenhuang/dsh-genui
dsh plugin --profile web add @changfenhuang/dsh-genui
```
(Note: these npm commands reinstall the **upstream** package. To refresh an install of this fork, rebuild from source and re-link instead — see Quick Start Option B.)
</details>

Q: The chat screen goes blank when rendering a fence? This version strictly requires DSH `^0.2.0-rc.1 || ^0.2.1-rc.1`. Older host versions lack necessary React slot/context capabilities; please upgrade DSH.

| Exploration Area | Decision | Rationale |
| :--- | :---: | :--- |
| **Incremental Diff Patching** | Declined | A fence costs only 200–800 tokens; resending is fast and safe. Teaching models a patch diff protocol introduces high friction and hallucination rates. |
| **Granular Action Delivery** | ✅ Done | Discrete gestures send immediately; continuous slider drags apply trailing-edge debounce to keep chat context clean. |
| **Cross-Session Replay Persistence** | Declined | Resetting on replay is the more natural expectation when the model updates the UI; state is preserved seamlessly during streaming. |
| **Separate Gallery / i18n Strings** | Declined | The component gallery is covered by `demo-prompts`, `gallery.ts`, and README screenshots; the core bundle carries only 6 built-in UI strings. |

--- `dsh-genui` 将大模型的文本回答无缝升级为**安全、可交互的原生 DSH 界面**。
例如当你询问「这个月订单表现如何？」，模型给出的回答不再只是一串文字，而是边打字边在正文中展开一张**可排序的数据面板**、一段**内嵌音视频**、一个**可拖拽调参的函数图像**、一组**即时判卷的测验**，或是一个**常驻的会话工作区**——文本与 UI 和谐共存，浑然一体。

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **本仓库是 `@changfenhuang/dsh-genui` 0.14.0 的 fork**（包名保持不变，可原位替换上游），版本 `0.14.0-fork.3`。相对上游：图示引擎替换为 **pele**（1.02 MB，较 mermaid −70%，CSS 变量实时跟主题，白名单加 mindmap/timeline），并新增能力——`chart` 的 `kind:"area"`、`input` 原生 `date`/`datetime-local`/`time`/`number` 类型与 `min`/`max`/`step` 约束、`table` 自动分页（`pageSize`，行上限提至 200），以及上游 **Computed 计算字段**（输入驱动的本地响应式重算，取自上游 0.15.0 修复线）。完整记录见 [FORK.md](./FORK.md) 与 CHANGELOG。**本 fork 未发布到 npm**——下方「快速开始」区分了上游 npm 安装与本 fork 的源码构建安装。

---

> [!NOTE]
> **真实截图与录屏：** 以下界面素材均直接截取自 DSH 真实对话环境中的渲染结果，无任何概念样机或预渲染伪造。演示素材沿用上游仓库——fork 完整继承这里展示的整套组件面，仅图示引擎不同（pele 替换 mermaid）。

`dsh-genui` 的所有组件与交互受严格的白名单规范约束，兼顾丰富表现力与高安全性。完整字段定义见 [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md)。

```
dsh-genui 核心能力矩阵
├── 🌊 1. 边流边渲染 (Streaming UI)
├── 🎨 2. 30+ 丰富组件生态 (Components Matrix)
├── ⚡ 3. 本地优先即时交互 (Local-First Experience)

- **回答即界面**：组件内嵌在回复正文中，跟随模型 Token 流式吐出，边生成边即时挂载，**无需等待整段回复输出完毕**。
- **零破坏降级**：若未安装或禁用插件，`dsh-ui` 围栏将退回为优雅的 Markdown 代码块，绝不破坏会话内容。

- **展示与排版**：包含指标卡（`stat`，支持 Hero 超大字号与微趋势线 Sparkline）、表格（`table`）、时间线（`timeline`）、代码对比（`diff`）、步骤条（`steps`）、文件树（`file-tree`，支持点击展开折叠）、提示卡（`callout`）、徽章（`badge`）等。
- **高级表格**：
  - 点击表头**纯本地排序**（升序/降序/还原，支持千分位、百分比、货币及万/亿数值感知）；
  - 单元格支持 `bar` 进度条、`ring` 环形、`spark` 趋势线，带正负符号数值自动着色；
  - 一键支持数据导出（复制 Markdown / CSV）与即时文本过滤（Filter）；
  - **自动分页**（fork.2）：超过 15 行的表格本地翻页；`pageSize` 可覆盖每页行数，合计与导出始终按全量数据计算。
- **ECharts 深度集成 (`echart`)**：
  - **预设简写模式**（`preset`）：支持 `bar`、`line`、`area`、`pie`、`scatter`、`radar`、`gauge`、`funnel`、`treemap`、`sankey`、`graph`、`heatmap`、`bigline`、`wordCloud` 等数十种图形，配色自动匹配 DSH 主题；
  - **完整配置模式**（`option`）：支持原生 ECharts 选项，轻松开启 DataZoom、VisualMap 等高级特性；
  - **按需异步加载**：ECharts 引擎（~1MB）独立打包，未调用图表组件的会话绝不加载多余代码。
- **数学函数绘图 (`plot`)**：
  - 支持多曲线绘制（line / area / scatter），公式支持三角函数、对数、幂运算等；
  - **动态参数滑块**：拖动滑块前端毫秒级重绘，锁定 Y 轴，支持自动动画循环演示。
- **Mermaid & 3D 场景**：流程图、序列图、甘特图、ER 图、gitGraph、思维导图与时间线（12 种白名单图型）由 **pele 引擎**驱动（fork：较 mermaid −70% 资产体积，换主题时已渲染图形实时重排）；另有轻量 3D 模型按需异步加载。
- **原生多媒体**：支持浏览器可直达的音频（`audio`）与视频（`video`）嵌入播放，包含封面图、比例自适应及播放控制。
- **数学公式集成**：基于 KaTeX，支持行内公式 `$...$`、块级公式 `$$...$$`，支持矩阵与多行推导。

readme.section: 3. ⚡ 本地优先即时交互 (Local-First Experience)
readme.text:
- **本地优先原则**：前端界面能够独立完成的操作（表格排序、过滤、内容展开/收起、标签切换、参数重绘、测验判题），**一律在浏览器本地即时完成**，绝不进行不必要的模型往返。
- **测验与本地判卷 (`quiz` / `submit`)**：
  - 单题测验点击即在本地判题、展示解析并支持重试；
  - 多题问卷/表单可通过 `submit` 统一交卷，支持 `groups` 必填项控制与进度感知。
- **状态持久化**：表单输入、单选多选与测验进度基于「会话 + 内容指纹」自动存入缓存（LRU 200 块），刷新页面或重开会话无缝恢复。

readme.section: 4. 🔄 闭环事件回传系统 (Action Event-Loop)
readme.text:
- **真实动作闭环**：当按钮或表单带上 `action` 字段时，用户的点击或提交会即时组装为结构化事件回传给大模型，触发下一轮智能分析。
- **诚实交互设计**：未声明 `action` 的按钮自动渲染为禁用态，杜绝“看起来可点但无反应”的假交互；点击有效按钮触发即刻给予视觉反馈。
- **智能防抖**：按钮与切换项单次手势单次发送，连续滑块拖动自动开启尾沿防抖，仅回传最终停顿值。

readme.section: 5. 📌 常驻会话工作台 (Session Panel & Templates)
readme.text:
- **常驻 Dock 面板**：支持通过 `/panel` 指令或 `panel: true` 将 UI 固化在输入框上方；支持鼠标拖拽边框调整高度；支持 `append: true` 增量追加标签页。
- **模板中心与成就系统**：
  - **模板中心**：点击 Dock 顶部的「模板」即可预览 11 类典型业务场景模板，一键插词唤起模型；
  - **探索成就**：内置 12 项探索趣味成就，本地计数记录使用足迹。

readme.section: 6. 🛡️ 安全沙箱与容错自愈 (Safety & Self-Healing)
readme.text:
- **严格安全防线**：所有组件严格受白名单结构约束，杜绝一切外部代码注入与 `eval` 执行；**严禁索取与收集密码、API Key 等任何敏感凭据**，密码类输入强制打码且绝不持久化。
- **同回合轮内自修 (Fence Steer Repair)**：若模型生成的 `dsh-ui` 围栏存在格式缺陷，插件自动捕获错误并在**同一回合内**将精确节点诊断反馈给模型，触发自主纠正与重发（可配置 `fenceFeedback: false` 关闭）。
- **节点级自愈降级**：单个语法异常节点被静默舍弃，同级其他正常组件继续完好渲染，绝不因个别节点错误拖垮整屏界面；Mermaid 常见语法缺陷自动修复重试。

> 上游的 npm-script 入口（`pnpm run build` / `check`、`scripts/*.mjs` 辅助脚本与 E2E 装置）不在本 fork 的 npm 快照内。以上三条即本 fork 的构建门禁；pnpm 11 的注意事项见 [FORK.md](./FORK.md)（直接调用二进制，不要经 `pnpm exec`/`pnpm run`）。

若需自定义插件行为，可在用户 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中调整：

```yaml
- id: genui
  name: '@changfenhuang/dsh-genui'
  config:
    renderUiTool: false   # 关闭额外注入的 render_ui 工具调用，仅保留正文 dsh-ui 围栏与 panel

---

Q: 为什么生成的 dsh-ui 仍然显示为普通代码块？ 1. 打开浏览器开发者工具（F12），切换到 Console 面板； 2. 检索是否有 `[genui] client active; fence-channel=dom` 日志： - **若没有**：说明客户端 Bundle 尚未被 DSH 宿主激活。请检查 `dsh plugin list` 确认插件已正确安装，并尝试重启 DSH web 与硬刷新浏览器； - **若已有**：检查模型输出的代码块标签是否准确为 `dsh-ui`，且内容为合法的 JSON。
Q: 提示 "pnpm not found on PATH"？

DSH 的插件管理需要调用宿主系统的 `pnpm`。请在系统终端执行 `corepack enable` 或 `npm i -g pnpm`，安装完成后**新开一个终端窗口**再执行 `dsh plugin add`。
Q: npm install 返回 404？ 本包是公开包（无需任何 npm 账号授权）。可先执行 `npm view @changfenhuang/dsh-genui version` 查看最新公开版本。若刚发布可能存在几分钟镜像同步延迟，请稍后重试。
Q: 3D 场景、Mermaid 或 ECharts 无法渲染？

图形重型引擎采用按需加载机制（首次使用时通过插件内置的静态路由拉取）。请先硬刷新网页（`Cmd + Shift + R`）；如果仍失败，可尝试重新安装插件： ```sh dsh plugin --profile web remove @changfenhuang/dsh-genui dsh plugin --profile web add @changfenhuang/dsh-genui ``` （注：上述 npm 命令重装的是**上游**市场版；若要刷新本 fork 的安装，请重新构建并 link——见「快速开始」方式 B。）
Q: 渲染 dsh-ui 时界面出现白屏？ 当前版本强依赖 DSH `^0.2.0-rc.1 || ^0.2.1-rc.1`。如运行在较老版本的 DSH 上可能存在 React 上下文兼容问题，请升级 DSH 宿主。

readme.section: 🗺️ 路线图评估 (Roadmap，继承自上游)
readme.text:
| 探索方向 | 评估结论 | 决策理由 |
| :--- | :---: | :--- |
| **增量 Diff Patch** | 暂不做 | 一条围栏仅消耗 200–800 Token，全量重发代价极小且极其稳定；Patch 差异协议的模型遵循成本与出错率反而偏高。 |
| **细粒度 Action 回传** | ✅ 已上线 | 按钮/表单离散手势立即回传；连续滑块拖动尾沿防抖，确保流畅度与模型上下文整洁。 |
| **跨会话深度状态继承** | 暂不做 | 新一轮对话由模型更新新 UI，状态重置是更合理的自然行为；流式输出期间状态已完整保留。 |
| **独立画廊与多语言抽取** | 暂不做 | 画廊素材已由 `demo-prompts`、`gallery.ts` 与 README 全面覆盖；核心内置文案仅数处，保持极简轻量。 |
